# Native saved linked-subtype fixture

Authored by Zamil for the Session/query receiving tests; no artist input.
Generated by `scripts/build-query-linked-fixture.py` with local Blender
5.2.1 LTS, build `9e2066aef7ef`, then reopened in that same native Blender.
`manifest.json` records the exact generated bytes and version.

The root compositor references `SharedTree` in `group-library.blend`. That
library has both a local tree and a same-named forwarding stub into
`forwarded.blend`. Local-first selection must choose the local tree. Saved
library references are relative; tests mutate only isolated writable copies.
No render, pixels, network access or evaluated-scene claim is involved.

The small checked-in files make native `Session::query` tests unconditional:
they cannot silently pass because an environment variable or Blender was
missing on the test runner. Rebuilding this fixture still requires Blender;
reading/testing it does not.
